shell_commands:
git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
test(orchestrator): acceptance tests for usage accumulation across tool rounds

Define DONE for #93 with acceptance tests that verify usage from all tool rounds
is accumulated into a sum and passed to afterModelResponse, not just the final
round's usage. Tests confirm that:
- Two-round tool turns accumulate summed tokens from both rounds
- No-tool turns report unchanged single usage
- Undefined usage in some rounds is skipped, others are summed
- All undefined rounds result in undefined, not 0 or NaN

This defines the ticket's requirements: acceptance tests fail for the right reason
(missing accumulation) and will pass once the feature is implemented.
Co-Authored-By: Claude Haiku 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)"
git merge-base --is-ancestor origin/main HEAD && echo "Main is ancestor" || echo "Main is not ancestor, need to merge"
git merge origin/main -m "Merge origin/main into loop-bench/93"
npm test -- src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.acceptance.test.ts 2>&1 | grep -E "Test Suites|Tests:|FAIL|● Chat" | head -20
